protocol: Exploratory frozen-config real-RGB evaluation on a subset of the official training partition; not an official test benchmark.
selection: Two subjects, both action sequences, three fixed time windows chosen before accuracy evaluation. Activity labels are approximate publisher block descriptions, not frame-level labels. No algorithm tuning in this run.
reference: annot3 markerless multiview motion-capture reference, not independent marker-based Vicon; 12 corresponding body joints only; do not use univ_annot3.
